purity_rule: call status exactly called, finite 0<purity<=1, unique array sample15, exact SNP6 aliquot in official quality file with all flags False; no fallback for noncanonical IDs
cohort: QC_v3 LF cohort, complete cases separately per model; no survival filter
method: rank score and LF; regress both ranks on intercept, rank purity (+ rank age and binary sex); correlate residuals; t approximation df=n-rank(design)-1
sex: MALE/FEMALE only; omit constant covariates; age 0-120
family: BH jointly across prior QC_v3 unadjusted tests and both new models, both branches and LF policies; matched-cohort unadjusted rho descriptive only
interpretation: conditional descriptive sensitivity; purity and immune fractions are compositionally coupled, adjustment may remove biology or introduce selection/collider bias; not causal effect, independent biomarker or clinical validation
